title.narrative: External Evaluation of the IDEAS Project in Benue State

description.narrative: CAFOD works in partnership with local organizations in Nigeria to address poverty, inequality, conflict, and vulnerability. In collaboration with Catholic Relief Services (CRS) and Caritas Germany, CAFOD provided funding to Caritas Nigeria for the "IDEAS Project." The IDEAS Project is a 12-month, multi-sectoral humanitarian and early recovery intervention designed to improve the wellbeing, dignity, and resilience of 11,449 vulnerable IDP households in Benue State. The context is driven by persistent farmer-herder conflict, necessitating a transition from emergency aid to self-reliance, with Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) positioned as a foundational investment alongside food security, livelihoods, protection, and social cohesion. As the project approaches a critical point for second-tranche funding, CAFOD is commissioning an independent evaluation to verify, assess meaningful change, examine partner systems, and provide actionable evidence for funding decisions. The exercise is learning-oriented and improvement-focused rather than fault-finding.
